propositions: get_issuelinks_map and get_comment_map use unpaginated search_issues calls that default to max_results=50, silently losing all issues beyond the first page in projects with more than 50 issues
Issue links beyond the first 50 are invisible to the differ, causing spurious link-creation mutations and inability to detect link removals
Comment sync is silently incomplete for issues beyond the first 50 due to unpaginated get_comment_map

A shared _paged_search helper must be extracted and used by get_issuelinks_map, get_comment_map, and get_parent_map to ensure all issues are paginated correctly by advancing on returned row count and terminating only on empty pages
